text: Debugging is an important skill for every programmer. When a program does not work correctly, the first step is identifying bugs. You need to find where the problem happens and what causes it. Good debugging tools, such as breakpoints and step-by-step execution, can help you examine your code closely. However, tools alone are not enough. You should also follow a systematic approach: test one change at a time and check the result before moving on. Another useful method is logging. By adding log messages to your code, you can see what the program is doing and catch errors more easily. With patience and practice, debugging becomes much simpler.
